name: Karnail Singh
headline: MERN Stack Developer Intern @ Sensation Software Solutions | React.js • Node.js • Express.js • MongoDB | Building scalable, high-performance web applications and secure cloud-native solutions.
about:
I am a passionate Full Stack Developer specializing in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) and cloud-native application development. With hands-on experience designing scalable web applications and secure RESTful APIs, I enjoy bridging the gap between elegant frontend interfaces and robust backend systems.

During my internships at Sensation Software Solutions and Edunet Foundation (in partnership with Microsoft & IBM SkillsBuild), I successfully deployed cloud-native serverless applications, built AI chatbots, and integrated secure authentication systems like JWT and RBAC. I focus on optimizing performance, whether improving page loads by 35% or boosting inventory efficiency by 60% in my full-stack projects.

Currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science, I am constantly exploring new technologies like blockchain development and cloud architecture. I thrive in collaborative, Agile environments where I can apply strong data structures, algorithms, and system design principles to ship production-ready features.

experience.title: MERN Stack Developer Intern
experience.description: Developed full-stack web applications using the MERN stack while collaborating in an Agile environment on live client projects. Built and deployed 5+ cloud-native serverless applications on IBM Cloud, achieving 99.2% uptime and reducing application provisioning time by 40%. Designed and integrated 12+ secure REST APIs using JWT Authentication and Role-Based Access Control.

experience.title: AI & Cloud Intern
experience.description: Completed two AICTE-certified virtual internships covering Artificial Intelligence, cloud computing, and IBM Watsonx. Developed and presented mentor-guided AI projects, including a Watsonx Orchestrate phishing detection agent and a Watsonx Assistant chatbot.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science
